# Motion bars chart

The motion-bars-chart recipe: a title pill opens into a chart card, the bars grow on a stagger and the values count up to the exact approved wording. The numbers are illustrative.

- Type: Motion bars chart
- Skill: `magnifito-promo`
- Engine: `motion`
- Output: 1920x1080, 5 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/s15-motion-bars-chart.mp4`](../videos/s15-motion-bars-chart.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 5 second 16:9 clip for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, in the motion-bars-chart style only: a chart titled "Leads per month (illustrative)" with three bars, before Magnifito 18, after three months 41, after six months 67. The numbers are illustrative: put them in claims.json and label the chart as illustrative. Use the motion engine. Brand colours are warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), Geist for type, English on screen.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- s15-motion-bars-chart
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/s15-motion-bars-chart/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo render . --format 16:9 --force
```

The finished file is `runs/*/final_output_*.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
